items.title: How Can Companies Measure Ethics and Good Judgment?
items.summary: Can companies measure qualities like ethics and good judgment—and hold their leaders accountable for them? Shellye Archambeau, operating partner at The ExCo Group, and Bob Toohey, chief people officer at Fidelity National Information Services, discuss how businesses can evaluate leadership behavior, build stronger workplace cultures and establish ethical guardrails for AI. They spoke with Wendy Bounds at the WSJ Leadership Institute Board of Directors Summit in Palm Beach, Florida.
